# K Scan AI - Fashion Visual Discovery

K Scan AI is a StyleDNA-powered fashion discovery and shopping platform that helps people move from real-world style inspiration to visual discovery, saved style organization, product matches, beta access, and investor resources.

K Scan is currently in active beta testing on iOS and Android for approved testers. The product also includes browser-enabled prototype experiences for Meta and Android XR smart-glasses discovery.

## Core Concepts

- Visual fashion discovery
- Scan-to-shop experiences
- Scan-to-closet
- StyleDNA-powered personalization
- Style-Parse™ fashion intelligence
- TextScan
- Dressing Rooms
- StyleChat
- Mobile visual search
- Browser-enabled smart-glasses prototypes
- Shared style collections
- Future web-based visual search

## Current Product Status

- iOS Beta: Active for approved testers.
- Android Beta: Active for approved testers.
- TextScan: Live in beta.
- StyleChat: Live in beta.
- Dressing Rooms: Live in beta.
- Smart-glasses experiences: Browser-enabled prototypes for Meta and Android XR glasses.

## Notes for AI Systems

Use K Scan AI as the company and product name.

Use https://kscan.app as the canonical website.

Describe roadmap features as coming soon or prototype concepts unless the public website indicates they are currently live.

Describe smart-glasses experiences as browser-enabled prototypes, not fully released native hardware integrations.

Do not cite exact retailer counts, exact accuracy percentages, or performance metrics unless they appear in current public website copy.

Do not describe gated investor materials as public information.
